first_dialogue.about: From boot to the first line of the story after New Game (the title menu: Load Game is locked without a save; no item is highlighted until a direction is pressed, then the highlighted one is pink with a Chinese caption). Trial 2026-10-20: the first story line at 19.2 s (RIGHT showed Gallery, LEFT New Game, A). The fixed script: RIGHT at 8 s, then A every 2 s.

screen.instructions: What is shown in `screen`, a frame of a visual novel game?

criteria.loading: A black or nearly black screen, a fade, a logo or a loading indicator
criteria.title: The title screen with its menu (Load Game, New Game, Gallery, Options)
criteria.notice: A notice, warning or confirmation box waiting for a button press
criteria.story: A story scene with a line of dialogue or narration text at the bottom

selected.instructions: On the title menu in `screen` (Load Game, New Game, Gallery, Options along the bottom left), which item is highlighted? A highlighted item is drawn in pink with a small Chinese caption under it; the others are plain white with no caption. Without a save Load Game shows a padlock: the padlock is not a highlight.

criteria.none: No title menu, or every item is plain white (none highlighted)

story_text.instructions: Is a line of story dialogue or narration text shown at the bottom of `screen`?
